question: Can the UK extradite a person who faces the death row phenomenon?
answer_text: Yes, but only within limits set by Article 3. In Soering v. the United Kingdom the Court held that extradition can itself engage the responsibility of the sending state where substantial grounds show a real risk of torture or inhuman or degrading treatment in the requesting country [001-57619§91]. Applying that test, it found that exposure to the 'death row phenomenon' in Virginia would breach Article 3 [001-57619§111].
